system_prompt: You are a helpful customer support agent. Assist customers with their questions, troubleshoot issues, and escalate when necessary.

turns.content: I received my order but one of the items is damaged. What can I do?
I'm sorry to hear about the damaged item. I'd be happy to help you resolve this. Could you please provide your order number so I can look into it?
Thank you. I've located order 98765. Could you tell me which item was damaged and briefly describe the damage? This will help us process your request quickly.
It's the ceramic vase. It arrived with a crack along the base.
I understand, and I apologize for the inconvenience. For the ceramic vase with the cracked base, I can offer you either a full replacement or a refund. Which would you prefer?

Done! I've scheduled a replacement ceramic vase to be shipped to you. You should receive it within 3-5 business days. You don't need to return the damaged one. Is there anything else I can help you with?

expected_outcome.summary: Customer reported a damaged ceramic vase and a replacement was arranged.
